# coolify_application_dockerimage (Data Source)

Read a Coolify docker image application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_application_dockerimage" "existing" {
  id = "application-uuid"
}

output "image" {
  value = "${data.coolify_application_dockerimage.existing.docker_registry_image_name}:${data.coolify_application_dockerimage.existing.docker_registry_image_tag}"
}

output "status" {
  value = data.coolify_application_dockerimage.existing.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Application UUID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Application description.
- `docker_registry_image_name` (String) Docker registry image name.
- `docker_registry_image_tag` (String) Docker registry image tag.
- `environment_variables` (Map of String) All non-sensitive environment variables currently set on the application.
- `fqdn` (String) Application domain(s).
- `name` (String) Application name.
- `ports_exposes` (String) Exposed ports.
- `ports_mappings` (String) Port mappings.
- `status` (String) Application status.
